package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// DiagnosticBootstrapBindingProvisioner is intentionally append-only. A
// provisioning conflict must be surfaced to rollout automation; it must never
// reinterpret, update, or delete a previously published binding.
type DiagnosticBootstrapBindingProvisioner interface {
	ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, bool, error)
}
